meta.title: Winnipeg new-construction project timelines

period_notes.2019: Only 82% of electrical and plumbing permits issued in 2019 have a final date (the open data has none for almost every trade permit issued from about 2020), so most buildings cannot be timed and the ones that can are not typical.
period_notes.2020: Only 40% of electrical and plumbing permits issued in 2020 have a final date (the open data has none for almost every trade permit issued from about 2020), so most buildings cannot be timed and the ones that can are not typical.
period_notes.2021: Only 1% of electrical and plumbing permits issued in 2021 have a final date (the open data has none for almost every trade permit issued from about 2020), so most buildings cannot be timed and the ones that can are not typical.
period_notes.2022: Only 0% of electrical and plumbing permits issued in 2022 have a final date (the open data has none for almost every trade permit issued from about 2020), so most buildings cannot be timed and the ones that can are not typical.
period_notes.2023: Only 1% of electrical and plumbing permits issued in 2023 have a final date (the open data has none for almost every trade permit issued from about 2020), so most buildings cannot be timed and the ones that can are not typical.
period_notes.2024: Only 1% of electrical and plumbing permits issued in 2024 have a final date (the open data has none for almost every trade permit issued from about 2020), so most buildings cannot be timed and the ones that can are not typical.
period_notes.2025: Only 1% of electrical and plumbing permits issued in 2025 have a final date (the open data has none for almost every trade permit issued from about 2020), so most buildings cannot be timed and the ones that can are not typical.
period_notes.2026: Only 1% of electrical and plumbing permits issued in 2026 have a final date (the open data has none for almost every trade permit issued from about 2020), so most buildings cannot be timed and the ones that can are not typical.
period_notes.2010: Winnipeg's trade permits start 2010-01, so buildings issued early in 2010 may have trade permits we cannot see.

meta.match: street address (number + name + type), issue dates within +-450 days, nearest wins
meta.licence: Building permits: Open Government Licence - Winnipeg (as used in municipal_permits_etl.py). Trade permits: Canada Open Government Licence (dataset metadata).
meta.basis: measured from city records; final dates are administrative
limitations: No inspection dataset, no gas permits and no residential HVAC permits in Winnipeg's open data.
Winnipeg's permit clock runs long; spans include administrative closing lag.
Trade permits issued from about 2020 almost never have a final date (82% closed for 2019, 40% for 2020, ~1% after), so only buildings issued through 2018 can be timed.
Row housing is not summarised: several building permits share one address and a trade permit attaches to only one.
Recent issue years only contain buildings already closed (right-censored).
Address join is ours, not a city key; one city only.
